description: This Java class contains integration tests for the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing the creation and modification of data tables with unique and indexed columns. It utilizes JUnit 5 for testing, Lombok for data classes, and MapStruct for data mapping. The class defines multiple test cases to verify table schema behaviors, including multi-row configurations, foreign key considerations, and column attributes such as uniqueness and indexation.

classes.name: DatatableUniqueAndIndexColumnTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the creation and update behaviors of data tables with unique and indexed columns in the Apache Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured settings and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testDatableCreationWithUniqueAndIndexedColumns
methods.description: Tests creating a data table with columns marked as unique and indexed, then verifies the table schema.

methods.name: testDatableModificationWithUniqueAndIndexedColumns
methods.description: Tests updating a data table by adding and changing columns' unique and index properties, then verifies the schema updates.

methods.name: testDatableCreationMakesFkColumnIndexedIfMultirow
methods.description: Verifies that foreign key columns are automatically indexed when creating a multi-row data table.

methods.name: testDatableCreationMakesFkColumnIndexedIfNotMultirow
methods.description: Checks indexing behavior of foreign key columns when creating a non-multi-row data table.

classes.name: NameUniqueIndexedHeaderData
classes.description: A data class representing columns' name, uniqueness, and index properties for schema validation during tests.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps ResultsetColumnHeaderData objects to NameUniqueIndexedHeaderData instances.
